note: Lobby goldens of spec 011 (FR-390, FR-392): for each dev secret, the roster (text sent and name stored, in join order), the predictions (concrete factions; `before` is the index of the step they are sent before), the events and public views of the lobby flow (public creation, clock timing) and of the operator flow (manual timing), the phase results with names, the who-guessed-right lists, the players results and the leaderboard at the end. A player is keyed by its name, a client player by its namespaced id. Written by generate-dev-lobby.ts from dev-secrets.json, the sim exports and its own arithmetic.
